text:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PD Alert fired: metrics.log-ingest-lag (severity: P1)
incidentbot: Details: job=log-ingest-consumers, consumer_group=log-consumer-prod, avg_lag_ms=120000, backlog=1.2M msgs. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/log-ingest-lag
pagerduty: New incident INC-3421 opened and assigned to samir (oncall). Escalation policy active.
samir: ack. I'm paged in, jumping onto metrics and consumer group. Pulling logs + consumer lag graphs.
anika: ping — any immediate customer impact seen?
samir: Grafana shows a sharp consumer lag spike at 09:12 UTC. Correlates with a deploy of `ingest-proxy:v2.3.4`. API 5xx rate up ~4% for writes to embeddings/ingest.
samir: Relevant logs (tail):
```
# kubectl logs deploy/ingest-proxy -n prod --since=10m
2026-03-14T09:11:58Z ERROR upstream request failed: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-14T09:12:05Z WARN commit failed: timeout writing to kafka
2026-03-14T09:12:07Z ERROR consumer loop crashed: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
```
maya: thought — last night's config change bumped buffer size + some JVM flags. Could be memory regression. Suggest scale consumers and restart ingest-proxy pods.
samir: scaling consumers now -> `kubectl scale deploy/ingest-consumer -n prod --replicas=8`
samir: command run, replicas scaling up. Watching consumer lag.
```
# kubectl get pods -l app=ingest-consumer -n prod
ingest-consumer-5b9c7   1/1   Running  0  10s
ingest-consumer-6d1a2   1/1   Running  0  8s
... total 8 pods
```
cody: If this impacts persisted customer latency we should notify ops and CS. I'll draft a short outbound note.
samir: consumers caught up ~09:20 UTC, avg_lag down to 30k msgs, but some 5xx errors persist. Investigating proxy pod health.
lee: check prometheus targets — any scrape failures for ingest-proxy exporters?
anika: prometheus `up{job="ingest-proxy-exporter"}` shows target down in eu-west-1 starting 09:10 UTC. Could explain delayed metrics and alerts flapping.
samir: found OOMKilled events on ingest-proxy pods shortly after deploy: `kubectl describe pod ingest-proxy-abc -n prod` -> container terminated with ExitCode 137.
maya: recommend rolling restart of ingest-proxy to pick fresh JVM heap flags and free leaked memory. Optionally rollback v2.3.4 if restarts don't stabilize.
samir: rolling restart now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-proxy -n prod`.
samir: restarted pods are coming up, readiness OK within ~45s. Monitoring errors.
anika: pager — if not stable in 15m escalate to lee and then to eng-sre pager.
pagerduty: INC-3421: note added — samir restarted ingest-proxy and scaled consumers. Next escalation window: 15 minutes.
samir: muted noisy alert to reduce fatigue: `incidentbot mute metrics.log-ingest-lag for 30m` (reason: mitigation in progress). :white_check_mark:
anika: can you confirm customer-facing impact summary for post-incident?
samir: summary: ~4% write requests returned 5xx between 09:11-09:22 UTC, peak error rate 09:12-09:16. Backlog peaked ~1.2M messages, consumers processed backlog down to <20k by 09:28. Affected subset: ingestion-heavy customers (top 12 by QPS).
cody: CS notified top 12 customers at 09:30 UTC; included mitigation steps and ETA. No critical SLA breaches reported so far; monitoring for late failures.
lee: please file postmortem with timeline and root cause hypotheses: probable memory regression in `ingest-proxy:v2.3.4` combined with consumer underprovisioning. Assign to samir + maya.
samir: Creating ticket INC-3421-PO now and adding action items.
Action items:
- samir: gather GC logs and full pod OOM traces (owner)
- maya: revert JVM flag change if confirmed (owner)
- anika: update runbook to include scaling play for consumer lag (owner)
- cody: follow up with customers and collect impact receipts (owner)
- lee: schedule blameless postmortem meeting for 2026-03-15 16:00 UTC (owner)
samir: monitoring shows lag steady and error rate back to baseline at 09:36 UTC. Will leave muted alert until postmortem.
anika: thanks — nice quick triage and escalation.
cody: customers acknowledged update. No escalations to leadership yet.
samir: closing PD incident for now; will add final notes to INC-3421 and keep watch into next shift. :eyes:
samir: closing thread — follow-up postmortem ticket: INC-3421-PO.
